Proven at the trip and versatile with regard to ground, he’s shaping like a well-handicapped type and rates the strongest option. Night Bear ran to form over this course and distance last time and represents a yard with a good record in this race; he's likely to be involved if allowed to dictate. Palazzo Persico wasn’t disgraced last time and should be suited by the return to 10f, though there’s a slight stamina question over further. Chourmo also has place claims if reproducing his latest Salisbury effort.

Kodi Fire disappointed on his latest outing but could bounce back under more suitable conditions.

selections.comment: THE THAMES BOATMAN has been in good form on turf of late and though he races off a higher mark on this surface it is with good reason. He can continue his excellent polytrack record from just 2lb above his last winning mark given his latest run has been boosted. Blazes Boylan has proven inconsistent in his short career but he has a fine strike rate over this C&D and should reverse form with Ziggy's Missile on these revised terms. Almaty Star arrives in good form and isn't dismissed either in a tight contest.

She finished first at Group level last year before being demoted by the stewards and has 3lb in hand on her nearest rival here. Cloud Cover was a narrow winner of the Prix Miss Satamixa on polytrack last year and looked in need of the run last time following a wind op. If back on song she will provide the biggest challenge ahead of Stop The Cavalry who was behind the selection last time when too keen but she should come on for that outing.

He can chase the selection home along with Trouville who was let down by a slow start last time when ahead of Surrey Fire and remains unexposed as a stayer.

selections.comment: KEEP ME STABLE won over 1m here last time, she has won from higher marks and could well follow up her latest course win given she has good form over 7f. Clasina is 14 without a win and remains a maiden, but has been in good form and is eased in grade here. She placed twice in Class 5's and will relish the drying ground. We can probably put a line through the latest effort of Without Delay, who never really got a chance. She's won three times at the track already and will hope a return here can bring improvement from a tempting mark. Purple Martini is not without a chance, the yard won this last year and she won here in her penultimate start.

selections.comment: Code Purple has a fantastic course record, prior to his slow start in his penultimate race has form of 22211 at the track and with top course jockey Paul Mulrennan taking the reigns looks to have another good chance. Detective has dropped a long way in the weights since winning last term at favoured Carlisle, but did run well here on season opener when placed in a big field. Shine On Brendan did win this race in 2022 and 2023 so it's worth keeping an eye on the market with him.

selections.comment: A tricky contest to call with a few in decent form here. Mrs Bagerran arrives off the back of a win at Ripon last time, but a 6lb rise means a career-best is needed - however she did win well last time. She held her form in the Blandford next time and if she is ready to go on her return a repeat of that would make her tough to beat. That form was given a boost over the weekend so she looks the biggest threat to the selection. Of those at bigger prices Sea The Boss could go well. She's been struggling since landing the Jannah Rose last year but the addition of cheekpieces may spark a revival.
